messages:
From: Sam Patel <sam@flybridge.ai>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 28 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Intro & quick fit questions — FlyBridge AI demo

Hi Connor,

I signed up for the self-serve sandbox yesterday and wanted to loop in to see if we could get a quick demo next week. High level: we're building a real-time summarization layer for support call transcripts and chat messages. A few quick data points to see fit:

- Typical request size: ~300–400 tokens (avg ~350)
- Monthly volume estimate: ~50M tokens now, planning to double in 3–6 months
- Latency preference: sub-200ms tail if possible for live UI
- Pilot timeline: hoping to start a small pilot in mid-July

I attached a small traffic sample (usage_sample.csv) that shows per-hour traffic and request size distribution. Can you let me know whether Redwood has an obvious fit, and share a couple of short slots for a 30 min run-through?

Thanks,
Sam Patel
Head of Product, FlyBridge AI
From: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sam Patel <sam@flybridge.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 28 Apr 2027 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro & quick fit questions — FlyBridge AI demo

Sam — thanks for the sample and context, this is helpful. Quick notes and a couple of follow-ups that will help us tailor the demo and resource suggestions:

1) Latency/throughput: sub-200ms tail for 350-token requests is achievable depending on concurrency and batching. Can you confirm expected peak concurrent requests (requests/s) during your busiest minute?
2) Token accounting: is the 50M tokens/month estimate inclusive of system prompts/metadata?
3) Data residency & retention: do you need logs/audit events retained or do you require strict zero retention for inference inputs?
4) Cloud region preference: us-west vs eu-west? We can demo in us-west for lowest latency to your users.

Proposed 30-min slots (Pacific TZ):
- Thu Apr 29 — 10:30am or 3:30pm
- Fri Apr 30 — 9:00am

If any of those work, feel free to pick on our Calendly: https://calendly.com/redwood-sdr/30min.

I'm attaching a short self-serve checklist (selfserve-checklist.pdf) that outlines recommended sandbox settings and a checklist we'll review on the call. I'll have Marissa join to cover security questions and Ben to touch on pricing/throughput sizing.

Connor O'Brien
SDR, Redwood Inference
From: Sam Patel <sam@flybridge.ai>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 28 Apr 2027 12:27:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro & quick fit questions — FlyBridge AI demo

Thanks Connor — answers below inline: 

> Can you confirm expected peak concurrent requests (requests/s) during your busiest minute?
We see peaks around 35–45 reqs/s (bursting up to ~60 for flash events).

> Is the 50M tokens/month estimate inclusive of system prompts/metadata?
No — that's user-generated tokens only. System prompts add ~5–8% on top.

> Data residency & retention?
We need logs stored for 90 days for observability; audit logs for 12 months. Not zero retention.

> Cloud region preference?
Users are primarily US-west with a small EU footprint, demo in us-west is fine.

I'm in IST (UTC+5:30) and the proposed Pacific slots map to inconvenient local times for me — is there any chance we could push to late afternoon Pacific or early evening my time? I could do Fri Apr 30 at 9:00am PT (which is 9:30pm IST) if that's workable.

I've attached a redacted set of sample transcripts (sample_transcripts_redacted.zip) that might help illustrate tokenization and context windows.

— Sam
From: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sam Patel <sam@flybridge.ai>

Sam — perfect, thanks for the fast answers and the sample transcripts.

- 5 min intros & scope
- 15 min demo (real-time summarization flow + latency/throughput discussion)
- 5 min sandbox checklist & next steps

Pre-call ask: if you can highlight one representative transcript in the zip you'd like us to demo with, we'll prioritize that and run price/throughput estimates in advance.
